Commentary.Commentary: Right then, this brings us to the end of this fascinating Test series between Bangladesh and Pakistan. Both the Test matches were closely contested but in the end, we have to say that Pakistan was a better team. They have clinched the series 2-0 and have also bagged 24 WTC points on the way. We will be back with more such thrilling action and till then, goodbye and cheers!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says that he enjoyed his bowling and he is glad that he got his first international wicket. Adds that their openers gave them a good start and their bowlers did a terrific job. Says that even though they lost a couple of days due to rain, they wanted to dominate the game and he is very happy with the win. Credits all the groundsmen by saying that they did a good job of covering the whole ground at all times.

The Bangladesh skipper, Mominul Haque, says that they had opportunity to get better in the second innings. He adds that middle order played well but they need to work on their top order. Tells that there were some positives for them and hopefully these players can continue their form in New Zealand.

Abid Ali is the Player of the Series. He says that the pitch was not easy to bat and it was turning. He adds that they wanted to play with a positive approach and everyone backed each other. He mentions that his domestic form helped him to perform in this series.

Sajid Khan is the Player of the Match for his brilliant bowling performance. He says that his captain and team management backed him and he is very happy. Tells that it is a team effort and everyone has contributed equally for the win.
Stay tuned for the Presentation!

Earlier in this game, Pakistan batters played pretty well on the tough Dhaka pitch as four batters notched up their fifty. The rain played spoilsport for almost two whole days and that made Pakistan declare for 300. Then, it was time for Pakistan bowlers to unleash their full potential and they did that in style as they bundled out Bangladesh for 87 runs. Bangladesh followed on and lost four wickets quickly but there was some sensible batting after that but eventually, it is Pakistan who have clinched a very unlikely victory here.

For the most part of the session, Pakistan bowlers didn't look like they will get four wickets in this session. But just when all hopes were fading, Babar Azam brought himself on and broke the partnership by dismissing Mehidy Hasan. Sajid Khan took his 10-wicket haul in the next over and soon followed it up with the 11th wicket. The last wicket took some time after that but Sajid Khan again came to the party and trapped Taijul Islam in front to hand Pakistan crucial 12 WTC points from this Test.

The final session saw Shakib Al Hasan and Mehidy Hasan batting sensibly but just when it looked like Bangladesh will salvage a draw here, Babar Azam displayed his magic and took the wicket of Mehidy Hasan. The well set Shakib Al Hasan also departed in the next over and in no time they were nine down with Khaled Ahmed perishing on duck. Taijul Islam and Ebadot Hossain played out some overs but Sajid struck again and ended with 12 wickets in this Test match, to hand Pakistan a very special win.

What a Test match this has been! When two days were almost completely washed off, very few believed that this Test will get a result. But Pakistan believed and played some quality cricket and in the end, with less than half an hour remaining in this Test match, they have clinched a victory here.
Review! Taijul Islam has been given out here! He has taken a review against it. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows three reds. So Taijul Islam is out and Pakistan have won this Test match.

OUT! LBW! There it is! Sajid Khan gets yet another wicket and does the job for his side! What a Test match this has proved to be! This was a flatter ball, around middle and going on with the angle. Ebadot Hossain at the non-striker's end asks his partner to review it immediately. Islam obliges but the Ball tracker indicates three reds and Taijul Islam is a goner! Pakistani players are over the moon! Pakistan WIN THE MATCH BY AN INNINGS AND 8 RUNS!

Pakistan bowlers found it difficult to get breakthroughs in this session as Bangladesh batters finally displayed some application out there in the middle. Sajid Khan eventually got the wicket of Liton Das and there was enough turn in the pitch to keep them interested. But some resilient batting by Bangladesh after that did not allow Pakistan to make further inroads. But just at the stroke of the Tea, the run-out of Rahim has brought them back into this game now. Can Pakistan take the remaining four wickets to clinch 12 WTC points from this Test match? All questions will be finally answered in the last session of this Test match coming our way. This is Test cricket at its best. Do join us for some intriguing action in the final session of this Test match at 3:00 pm Local time ( 9:00 am GMT).

The session started with Liton Das and Rahim building up a nice partnership much to the frustration of Pakistan bowlers. But just when things were getting calmer for Bangla Tigers, Liton Das perished at the score of 45 while trying to pull a half-tracker. The experienced duo of Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan then got together and stitched together a nice partnership as they combined caution with aggression beautifully. But just at the stroke of Tea, the brain-fade moment from two batters sent Rahim back to the pavilion as he was run-out. Bangladesh still trail by 66 runs. Will the run-out cost them this Test match? We shall find out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! Mushfiqur Rahim gets out just at the stroke of Tea and he would be absolutely gutted with himself! This is a huge moment in the context of this game and it is surely a body blow for Bangladesh. This was needless from Rahim and it could cost Bangladesh in the end. It was a flatter ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it to mid-wicket and goes for a run. Abdullah Shafique at mid-wicket collects the ball cleanly and throws it to the keeper Mohammad Rizwan who whips the bails off. Mushfiqur Rahim puts in a dive but his bat bounced off the ground and wasn't grounded before Rizwan took the bails off. The TV umpire has a good look at it and gives it out in the end. Mushfiqur Rahim walks back in anger and that will be Tea on Day 5.
They have gone upstairs for a Run-Out appeal! Mushfiqur Rahim has dived at the batter's end and can that save him? No, he has been given out! Big blow for Bangladesh.

Mushfiqur Rahim at the non-striker's end collides with the bowler but he manages to get up and reach the striker's end with a dive. The throw is a bit wayward at the keeper's end and Rahim was home.
On a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim defends it out watchfully.
Tossed up, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim gets behind the line of the ball to block.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to guide it past the slip fielder but Babar Azam at first slip dives to his right and stops the ball.
Tossed up, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan reverse-sweeps it towards deep backward point for a run.
Fuller and wider, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan leaves it alone.
Flatter ball, outside off and turning in sharply. Shakib Al Hasan stays back to cut but he misses as the ball goes past his blade.
Fuller-length delivery, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan squeezes it out to mid on and scampers through for a single.
Nicely tossed up, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan keeps it out.
Flatter ball, around off and spinning away late. Shakib Al Hasan looks to poke at it but he misses.
Loopy ball, on a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim sweeps it towards deep square leg and collects a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim skips down and eases it to mid on.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it to wide of backward point and takes a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it to backward point for one.
A quicker one this time, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim hangs back to block it but he gets a thick inside edge which goes towards short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets back in his crease and cuts it to extra cover.
Loopy ball, outside off and spinning away sharply. Mushfiqur Rahim misses his sweep and the ball goes to Babar Azam at first slip.
Into the blockhole, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim digs it out.
Tossed up, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it watchfully. A maiden over from Sajid Khan!
Flatter ball, down leg. Shakib Al Hasan gets back in his crease and leaves it alone.
Fuller in length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it watchfully off the front foot.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan works it to backward point.
Tossed up, around off. Shakib Al Hasan keeps it out.
Flatter ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter length, on off. Pushed off the back foot towards covers.
Once again there is some turn and bounce! Slightly shorter in length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim lets it turn and pushes it to backward point.
Shorter length, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to mid on for a single.
On the pads, this time.  Nudged to square leg.
Nauman Ali (7-1-22-0) comes back to bowl.

Squared him up! Tossed up on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to defend it off the back foot but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races towards the third man area and the batters run three. Good running there.
Slightly shorter length and turning away. Shakib Al Hasan looks to work it away but gets the outside edge square on the off side.
Slightly quicker on off. Shakib Al Hasan is well forward to block it.
Slower in the air, on middle. Hasan blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off this time. Defended solidly off the front foot.
Fuller on off. Driven to the cover fielder this time.
Tossed up on off. Hasan blocks it out.
A length ball, on off. Rahim defends this solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length, on off. Rahim blocks it off the back foot.
Full ball, on middle and leg. Hasan works it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
Overpitched this time, around off. Rahim leans forward and drives it through covers. The fielder running behind it cuts it off and the batters have taken three runs.
A length ball and outside off. Rahim defends this behind square on the off side.
Another flatter delivery on off. Shakib Al Hasan defends this again watchfully.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Blocked by Hasan.
Slower in the air on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to covers.
Fuller on middle. Hasan pushes it to mid on.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Hasan defends this off the back foot.
Turning from middle into leg. Rahim sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Another length ball on off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it watchfully again.
On a length, on off. Defended off the back foot this time.
FOUR! Three in a row now! Another overpitched delivery, around off. Shakib Al Hasan leans forward yet again and this time drives it through cover-point for another boundary.
FOUR! Another one, this time even better! Another half-volley on off. Shakib Al Hasan leans forward and finds the gap between mid off and covers to perfection for a boundary.
FOUR! This time he connects the drive! A full ball this time, on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive it on the up as the ball just misses the outside edge of his blade.

DRINKS! Bangladesh have managed to play out the first hour after Lunch by losing just one wicket but they still have a long way to go! They have their two most experienced batters at the crease and the hosts would hope that they do not lose anymore wickets going into the Tea interval. Pakistan, on the other hand, will look to break this partnership and run through Bangladesh's batting lineup.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Tossed up on off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets on his knees and sweeps it aerially towards deep square leg for a boundary. Safe shot!
Shorter length and outside off. Rahim cuts it to backward point for a couple.
On middle and leg. Turning into the batter. Rahim tucks it square on the on side.
On off and middle. Rahim blocks it off the back foot.
Darted on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan looks to work it away but gets hit on the thigh and gets a leg bye behind square on the on side.
On middle and leg from 'round the wicket, going in with arm. Hasan blocks it out.
A length ball again, this time outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone.
Again that shape into the batter. Rahim blocks this length delivery on off towards the on side.
A length ball and nips in slightly. Rahim defends this off the front foot towards the on side.
A full ball and shaping into the batter. Rahim pushes it back to the bowler.
A length ball again, on off. Rahim blocks it watchfully under his eyes.
On a length, on off. Rahim defends this off the front foot towards the off side.
Shorter length again, around leg. Rahim pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Shorter length on middle and leg. Blocked off by Rahim off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on middle. Rahim defends this off the front foot.
On off. Rahim gets back and defends it.
Shorter length, on middle. Rahim tucks it to the on side.
Tossed up on off. Flicked to short mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan works it to mid on.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Shakib Al Hasan keeps it out watchfully.
Fuller in length, on off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it.
Length ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to wide of cover and collects a couple.
Short of a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan defends it to cover.
Back of a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it out.
Shorter in length, around off and spinning in late. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to mid-wicket.
A quicker one this time, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Mushfiqur Rahim dabs it into the deck.
Flatter ball, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and works it to wide of mid on for a run to get off the mark.
Tossed up, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan leaves it alone.
Shakib Al Hasan walks in at number 7.

OUT! TAKEN! Liton Das has thrown it away and he stands in disbelief! A half-tracker, around off. Liton Das stays back and looks to pull hard but he hits it straight to Fawad Alam at square leg who juggles it but takes it in the end. A much-needed breakthrough for Pakistan and they are delighted! Bangladesh lose their fifth wicket and are in deep trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c Fawad Alam b Sajid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Full ball, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim gets forward and works it to mid on.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Liton Das pushes it to wide of mid on for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim nudges it to the leg side and collects a run.

Good-length delivery, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
Hasan Ali is into the attack now.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Liton Das gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.

Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Liton Das prods and blocks it out.

Back of a length, down leg. Mushfiqur Rahim stays back and nudges it behind square on the leg side for a run.

FOUR! Good shot! Fuller delivery and around off. Liton Das gets forward and opens the face of his blade to drive it square on the off side for a boundary.
Around off and turning in with some bounce off the deck. Das gets across and gets hit on the gloves as he looks to defend it off the back foot.
Tossed up on off. Defended off the front foot.
On middle and leg. Das gets deep in his crease and defends it.
A length ball, on off. Rahim defends this solidly off the back foot.
A good-length delivery and angling across. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to poke at it as the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length and outside off. Rahim decides to let it go.
Back of a length, on middle and some extra bounce there. Rahim looks to defend and gets it off the handle of his blade towards the on side.
A good bouncer this time, on middle. Rahim ducks under it.
A length ball and outside off. Rahim leaves it alone.
Again fuller and around off. Das drives it again to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up on off. Driven to covers.
Shorter length around off. Rahim pushes it off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
On off and turning in. Rahim defends this off the back foot.
Shorter length again, on middle. Das tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Around off and turning in. Das gets across and looks to tuck it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Shaheen Afridi ends the over with another short ball. Mushfiqur Rahim ducks under it comfortably.
Short again on off this time. Das jumps and just pushes it uppishly towards deep backward point for a single.
Short ball again and this time down the leg side. Das ducks under it.

Another short ball from 'round the wicket. This time it is angled into the body. Liton Das sways away from the line of the ball and the ball just misses his gloves by a whisker. They think of a review but decide going against it in the end.
Short ball and outside off. Das lets it go this time.
Back of a length, on leg. Rahim tucks it to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg. Clipped to square leg for a single.
Sharp turn and bounce! Tossed up around off. Rahim goes on the back foot and looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal but no damage done.
Tossed up on middle. Rahim pushes it off the front foot towards mid off.
Tossed up on off. Rahim defends this off the front foot.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Pushed to mid on..
Shorter in length on off. Rahim rocks back and punches it through covers for a couple.
On a length, on off. Defended solidly off the back foot.
Angling into middle from 'round the wicket. Nudged to mid-wicket.
On a length , on off. Das blocks it out.
On a length, on off. Das looks to leave it at the last moment but gets the underedge of his blade back to the keeper.

FOUR! Another boundary for Liton Das! Drifting on the pads this time and Liton Das clips this off his pads towards deep square leg for a boundary. Sloppy fielding in the deep there and that rolls towards the fence.
A length ball, on off. Das defends this off the back foot.
Who will start from the other end? Shaheen Afridi it is.
Tossed up on off. Rahim looks to sweep but misses and gets rapped up on the pads. But the impact is outside off.
Quicker and flatter on off. Rahim dabs it to the on side.
Tossed up on off. Rahim defends this off the front foot.
Shorter again on middle and leg. Das pulls it to the fielder at deep square leg this time.
Fuller and outside off. Das gets across and defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Liton Das starts the session with a boundary! Shorter in length on middle and leg. Liton Das rocks back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
The second session is about to get underway! The players of Pakistan make their way out on the field and they are followed by Mushfiqur Rahim and Liton Das. Sajid Khan will start for Pakistan.
...DAY 5, SESSION 2...

The same story continued for Bangladesh as they were bundled out for just 87 in the first innings. The poor show continued when they were made to follow-on as the top order crumbled against the pace and swing of two Pakistan seamers. Since then, Rahim and Liton Das got together and have stitched together a decent partnership to take them to Lunch without further damage. They are still 141 runs behind and have to bat two sessions out from hereon to salvage a draw here. Do join us for the second session which will begin at 12.40 pm Local (6.40 am GMT).

Another dominating performance by Pakistan bowlers. They came out in the morning with three more wickets needed to bundle out Bangladesh in the first innings and they did that pretty quickly as Sajid Khan finished with eight wickets under the belt and Shaheen Afridi took one wicket. They came back in the second innings as Bangladesh were made to follow-on and seamers got into the act immediately as they picked two wickets apiece to restrict Bangladesh to 25/4 in the ninth over. They have picked seven wickets in the first session and are just six wickets away from getting a famous win here.
Flighted delivery, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim eases it to mid on. That will be Lunch on Day 5.
Fuller in length, way outside off. Liton Das drives it to wide of deep cover and takes a single.
Tossed up, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it to wide of cover and takes off a run.
On a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
FOUR BYES! Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone and the ball stays low to go past the keeper. The ball races away to the fence.
Fuller in length, outside off. Liton Das drives it to extra cover and collects a single.
Loopy ball, around leg. Mushfiqur Rahim turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim tucks it to the leg side.

On a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim defends it off the front foot.

Flatter ball, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
A tad short, outside off. Liton Das stays back and cuts it to extra cover for a single.
On a length, around middle. Liton Das prods and keeps it out.

Loopy ball, outside off. Liton Das drives hard to the cover fielder who fumbles and the batters take a run.

Tossed up, on middle. Liton Das eases it to mid on for one.
FOUR! Liton Das is on the charge! Fuller in length, on middle. Das shimmies down and tonks it to wide of mid on and bags another boundary.
FOUR! In the air...but just wide of the mid-wicket fielder! Tossed up, around off. Liton Das skips down and heaves it to wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up, around off. Liton Das blocks it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it to mid off for a run.

Sajid Khan is into the attack now.

A fuller ball again. Defended off the front foot.
Fuller on off. Das drives it to covers.
Tossed up on off. Defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! A short ball, on off. Liton Das rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

BEATEN! Nicley tossed up on middle. Liton Das presses forward to defend but the ball turns away and misses the outside edge of his blade. The replays now show that there was a spike of his blade on UltraEdge but Pakistan did not appeal.

A length ball, on off. Nips back in a little. Rahim looks to defend it off the front foot and gets the inner half of his blade towards the on side.
Very full on middle this time. Almost a yorker! Rahim blocks it out in the end.
A full ball on middle this time. Rahim pushes it to mid on this time.

Fuller on off. Driven through covers for a couple. This is what he tried to do in the previous ball also.
In the air...but safe! Tossed up around off. Liton Das looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball falls just short of the point fielder.
An arm ball angling into off. Das blocks it off the back foot.
Another loopy delivery on off. Defended off the front foot towards the off side.
Tossed up this time on off. Das defends this off the front foot.

Fuller on middle this time. Driven to mid off this time.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Das gets back and defends it.
Tossed up on off. Defended off the front foot.
Back of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim stays back and blocks it to cover.
Short of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone.

A stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! A length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim prods and looks to defend but he misses and gets hit on his pad. Faheem Ashraf appeals but the impact was way outside off.
Short of a length, angling in from outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to defend but he gets the inside edge onto his pad.
Back of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone watchfully.
Length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim presses forward but lets it through to the keeper.
Tossed up, around off. Liton Das defends it off the front foot.

Fuller in length, around middle. Liton Das prods and works it to mid on.

Back of a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pad and the ball dabs onto the deck. A maiden over from Faheem Ashraf!
Good-length ball, around leg. Mushfiqur Rahim tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim stays back and lets it through to the keeper.

Length ball, outside off, nipping in late. Mushfiqur Rahim sways away from the line of the ball.

Drinks! What a phase of play for Pakistan! They have not only taken the remaining three wickets they needed in the first innings but have also picked up four more wickets in this second innings. Bangladesh batters have looked all at sea and were made to follow on this morning but have crumbled again now. With just six wickets needed for Pakistan to win this game, it looks a daunting task for Bangladesh to save this Test now. Faheem Ashraf is into the attack now.
Flatter ball, around off. Liton Das hangs back and punches it to backward point.
Flatter ball, on off. Liton Das defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up, down leg. Mushfiqur Rahim gets down on his knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.

Length ball, outside off, staying a touch low. Liton Das stays back to block but he misses as the ball goes under his bat.

OUT! Caught! Another one bites the dust! Back of a length delivery on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto pokes at it tentatively and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies off his blade to gully and Fawad Alam there takes a sharp catch. Bangladesh are four down with almost nothing on the board! The Bangladesh top order is again back into the hut cheaply.
Commentary.Howout: c Fawad Alam b Shaheen Afridi

Review! Mominul Haque has taken a review after being adjudged LBW! It looks close. Is there any bat involved? Seems that the ball is very close to the bat and this is a tough one for the TV umpire. No bat involved says the third umpire and the Ball Tracker shows three reds.

OUT! LBW! The skipper departs now! A length ball, on off. The ball came back in sharply from the angle. Mominul Haque looks to defend this off the front foot but misses. The ball hits his pads and Pakistan players appeal. The umpire raises his finger but Mominul Haque reviews it. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that it is pad first. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows three reds. So Mominul Haque has to walk back and Bangladesh lose their third wicket.
On the pads this time. Haque clips it to mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Classy shot! Overpitched delivery and outside off. Mominul Haque leans forward and drives it beautifully through cover-point for a boundary.
In the air...but safe! A length ball, on off. Mominul Haque is early in his drive and gets the bottom of his blade towards covers aerially for a single.

Good-length delivery and around off. Haque decides to leave it alone.
Almost squared him up! Full ball and angling into middle. Haque looks to work it away towards the on side but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Mominul Haque walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Both the openers are back into the hut now! A length delivery on off and nips back in sharply. Shohidul Islam looks to defend it but misses. The ball hits his pads and Afridi appeals. The umpire raises his finger and Shaheen Afridi is elated. Bangladesh are in real trouble now.

Full ball, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it out.
Length ball, around middle and shaping away a bit. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards backward point.
Najmul Hossain Shanto walks in at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Hasan Ali strikes and Bangladesh lose their first wicket! Length ball, just outside off and nipping back in, Mahmudul Hasan Joy prods and looks to drive through covers but the ball sneaks through his bat and crashes onto his off pole. Hasan Ali is elated!
Length ball, angling in from middle and leg and going down leg. Mahmudul Hasan Joy misses his flick.
Full ball, darted on the pads. Shadman Islam clips it past the mid-wicket fielder and collects a couple of runs.
Full ball, way outside off and shaping away late. Shadman Islam presses forward but does not offer any shot to this one.
Length ball, outside off. Shadman Islam leaves it alone.
Another ball, down leg. Shadman Islam misses his flick.
FOUR BYES! A very wayward ball, down leg. Shadman Islam lets it be. Mohammad Rizwan behind the sticks dives to his right but the ball goes past him into the fine leg fence.
Full ball, around leg. Mahmudul Hasan Joy flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Shadman Islam leaves it alone.
Length ball, nipping in from outside off. Shadman Islam shoulders arms to this one.
Short of a length, outside off. Shadman Islam lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller in length, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy clips it to fine leg and collects a run.
Good-length delivery, around off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it out.
FOUR! Mahmudul Hasan Joy and Bangladesh are underway! Ali serves a half-volley, on the pads. Mahmudul Hasan Joy flicks it towards the vacant fine leg region for a boundary.
Hasan Ali will start from the other end.
Length ball, outside off. Shadman Islam lets it be.
Length ball, around middle. Shadman Islam blocks it towards cover-point without any feet movement.
Full ball, way outside off. Shadman Islam shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length, outside off. Shadman Islam leaves it alone.
Length ball, on off. Shadman Islam blocks it watchfully off the front foot.
A Jaffa to start with! Good-length ball, around the fourth stump channel and curling away late. Shadman Islam looks to defend but the ball goes past his blade.
